faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU) is conducting this recruitment for Agricultural College, Naira.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited through this notification?
faq.answer: One post of Teaching Associate in the Agronomy department is being recruited on a purely temporary and contractual basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Teaching Associate position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15.10.2026 at 1.30 P.M.

faq.question: Q5. What time should candidates register on the interview day?
faq.answer: Candidates must register their names before 9:30 AM on the day of the interview at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the relevant subject, or a Master's Degree in the relevant subject, or a Bachelor's Degree of 4/5 years with first division, along with specified experience and research publication requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 40 years for men and 45 years for women.

faq.question: Q8. What is the monthly remuneration for the post?
faq.answer: Master's Degree holders receive Rs. 61,000/- per month plus applicable HRA, and Ph.D. degree holders receive Rs. 67,000/- per month plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will take place at Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent position?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely temporary and contractual for a period not exceeding 11 months or until the filling of a regular post, whichever is earlier.
